title: The Lasso app is 'stuck' in the Dynamic Island
body:
If tapping the Dynamic Island (the black shape around the front-facing camera) opens the Lasso app when an alarm is no longer active or snoozed, it may be 'stuck.'

This seems to be an issue that occurs when the Live Activity from the alarm is dismissed in certain ways, for example, swiping the Live Activity away instead of tapping on it.

The only way we've found to resolve this is to restart your iPhone. The Dynamic Island should return to normal afterwards.
